tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window and strip base, under the auras. Sky is the default light blue; Night follows Live's dark themes.

tokens.name: orb-1
tokens.usage: The large circle behind a window, partly under the glass so the frost has colour to blur.

tokens.name: orb-2
tokens.usage: The second, lighter circle behind a window, opposite orb-1.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The frosted window frame and the device strip. Always with glass-edge, blur-glass and shadow-rim. Hot text never sits directly on it, only hot marks.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on every glass tile.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Crisp cards inside the frosted frame. Charts and hot text live here.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on cards.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside glass: segmented tracks, chart wells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and chart gridlines on glass.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unlit gauge ticks and empty bar tracks on glass.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, lit ticks and the mix line on glass. At least 12:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on glass. At least 6:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Axis labels, timestamps, captions and the reference line on glass and cards. At least 4.5:1, even with orb-1 under the glass.

tokens.name: tile-top
tokens.usage: Top of a blue hero tile's gradient, where its title sits.

tokens.name: tile-base
tokens.usage: Body of a blue hero tile.

tokens.name: tile-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of a blue hero tile, under the chart. No text here.

tokens.name: tile-core
tokens.usage: The dark blurred core inside a blue hero tile that gives it depth.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Text, the mix line and lit marks on a blue hero tile. 5.8:1 on tile-base.

tokens.name: on-tile-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and axis labels on a blue hero tile, in its top half. At least 4.7:1.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: The navy tile for the one thing to fix first. One per view.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on the solid tile.

tokens.name: on-solid-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the solid tile.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Value chips that float on charts (1:32, -8.2 LUFS). White mono text on it.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary button fill, the playhead and the reference tick on gauges.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill. 5.9:1 sky, 9.8:1 night.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: solid 2px ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: A problem as text or marks on cards (5.2:1 on card), or as marks only on glass: the harsh band, drift lines, a High tag.

tokens.name: hot-glow
tokens.usage: A problem on a blue hero tile or the solid tile: the glowing band and gap fill. Marks only, at least 3:1.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Fine or fixed, as text or marks on glass: aligned hits, an Applied tag.

tokens.name: good-glow
tokens.usage: Fine or fixed on a blue hero tile or the solid tile.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: Too little compared with the reference: under-filled sections, a chorus that doesn't lift, a band that's too narrow. The partner of hot.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Worth a look, as text or marks on glass. Always with the word Watch.

tokens.name: action-glow
tokens.usage: The soft coloured glow under the primary pill button.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Geist, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Geist Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: SF Pro on a Mac through the system font, never shipped as a file. Geist everywhere else, bundled under the SIL Open Font License.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number a tile is about. Thin and large, tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: The number in a small tile or the device strip.

styles.name: tile-title
styles.usage: Tile titles and the advice headline.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Times, bars, deltas and chip values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons, inside segmented controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between bento tiles, strip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margin of a window.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented items, wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, advice cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bento tiles and the device strip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags and dots.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Every tile. Lifts it off the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-rim
tokens.usage: Bright top edge of glass tiles and buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-rim-tile
tokens.usage: Rim of blue hero and solid tiles.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on glass, with saturate(140%).

tokens.name: blur-aura
tokens.usage: Softness of the aura fields.

tokens.name: blur-core
tokens.usage: Softness of a hero tile's dark core.
